scripts.dev: node init && pnpm --filter @rybbit/shared build && pnpm -r --parallel --stream run dev
scripts.dev:client: node init && pnpm --filter @rybbit/shared build && pnpm --filter client... --parallel --stream run dev
scripts.dev:server: node init && pnpm --filter @rybbit/shared build && pnpm --filter rybbit-backend... --parallel --stream run dev
scripts.build:client: node init && pnpm --filter client... run build
scripts.build:server: node init && pnpm --filter rybbit-backend... run build
